decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of black cottonwood: finely toothed, broadly ovate blades 7 to 15 cm, whitish beneath, on petioles of 3 to 6 cm, yellow in autumn and drying brown; spent catkins. Colours and curl chosen by eye; numbers plausible, not measured.
